coordinate_system: Existing model X long0..50000, Y depth0..20000, Z floor0/3600/7200/10800, mm. Source dimensions unmeasured.
calculation_method: Offline convex separating-axis checks of persisted tread quadrilateral prisms and actual35mm oriented handrail boxes reconstructed from the original generator. Native current child bounds checked against generated layout; actual native beam solid boxes from all75 frame children. No SketchUp writer used. Does not infer collision from bounding-box overlap alone. Low clearance measured only over tread portions within beam footprint; not entire tread width. Native readback cannot expose arbitrary vertices, so sub-mm intersection shape remains generator-based rather than a fresh boolean volume test.
